# Python 0.1 migration fixture
python-v0.1.0.json records a synthetic java-spring consumer installed by the original Python CLI from
commit 97da9d1b09be803a283836646faf674b5ad5fe06. User-owned AGENTS text and local.md were added afterward.
Tests materialize the original bytes and hashes, check them with Node, then upgrade. No CRM data is included.

npm-v0.2.0.json is a real synthetic java-spring install from c4d94038b7edfc3dc707790cba6be2cd7d9f38c9, with appended user AGENTS notes. It verifies metadata replacement and skill additions in 0.3.

## npm-v0.12.0.json

Actual all-adapter/all-capability installation generated from source commit d8091a7fbb27bde4a7ccd979b90588be3b20ecdb, tree 191a2fea0cd44613f5e66b8c482892af839db1d3. Brotli/base64 keeps the snapshot compact; tests verify the decompressed SHA-256 and path/count/version before restoring into isolated temp projects. Used for real retirement/config/native bridge update tests, not model execution evidence. Reproduce with built-in zlib from that reviewed source's installer output. Development fixture is excluded from npm.
